instruction: When the elevator door is fully open, remind me.
expected_action: Remind me that the elevator door is fully open.
notes: Doors opening at 9.5-10.5 s; first clearly fully open at 10.5 s. End time conservatively limited to last clearly visible sampled frame.

instruction: When the elevator reaches the 45th floor and the door opens, remind me.
expected_action: Remind me that the elevator has reached the 45th floor and the door is open.
notes: Floor indicator clearly displays 45 by 6.0 s, with doors closed; doors begin separating around 7.5 s and are clearly opening at 8.0 s. Instruction requires door opens, not fully opens. Door remains open at 9.5 s; camera turns away afterward.

instruction: When you see a white Tesla, remind me.
expected_action: Remind me that there is a white Tesla nearby.
notes: A distinct white Tesla-like vehicle at the pillar becomes clearly visible at 09.0 s (front and headlights), and remains visible through 13.5 s. Brand identification inferred from vehicle appearance, not independently confirmed from a readable badge; please manually confirm it is a Tesla before finalizing ground truth. Other white cars occur earlier and must not count.

instruction: When you see a restroom sign, remind me.
expected_action: Remind me that a restroom sign is visible.
notes: restroom pictogram/sign is around 8.5s per recorder; multiple unrelated signs act as distractors.

instruction: When you see someone lower an umbrella, remind me.
expected_action: Remind me that someone has lowered an umbrella.
notes: A person has lowered an umbrella at around 7.0-10.0.

instruction: When the cup becomes empty, remind me.
notes: Negative example per recorder: no unambiguous observed transition from a nonempty cup to an empty cup. Other cups and drinks remain visible; foreground cup content is not reliably discernible.

instruction: When I take my phone out of my bag, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that the phone has been taken out of the bag.
notes: At 7.0-8.0s the hands are interacting with the bag; the phone is first clearly outside the bag and held in a hand at the 8.0s sampled frame. The event completes at 8.5s; the phone remains visible through 10.5s. Review if instruction should mean the action completion only.

instruction: When you see a white Electric vehicle driving, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that a white electric vehicle is driving by.
notes: A white car appears first, followed by a white electric vehicle at the 5.5-second mark.

instruction: When the main image on the computer screen shows two dogs together, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that two dogs are shown together in the main image on the screen.
notes: The main displayed image shows a single dog at 3.5-5.5s; at 6.0s it switches to a picture showing two dogs simultaneously and remains on screen through the final sampled frame at 11.5s.

instruction: When you see a dog, remind me.
notes: Negative video. No clearly identifiable puppy appears in the reviewed. The correct response is WAIT throughout.

instruction: When the traffic light turns green, remind me that it is time to go.
expected_action: Remind me that the traffic light has turned green.
notes: At 5.0 s the observed vehicle traffic light is still red; at 5.5 s it is green for the first clearly identifiable. The observed light is for vehicles, not necessarily a pedestrian crossing signal. End time reflects the last confirmed sampled green-light frame, not necessarily the exact end of the green phase.

instruction: When the main image on the computer screen shows a cat and a dog together, remind me.
notes: Negative compositional example. A cat and a dog do not appear together in the same main displayed image; individual animal images do not satisfy the instruction. The earlier image-search results contain multiple thumbnails, so the condition is explicitly restricted to the main image and not separate thumbnails visible at the same time. Correct response: WAIT throughout.

instruction: When the elevator door opens, remind me.
notes: Negative example. The elevator doors remain closed throughout the video; the opening condition never occurs.

instruction: When you see a small fountain, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that a small fountain is nearby.
notes: A low rectangular water fountain becomes clearly identifiable near the left side at 8.0s as the camera turns toward it. Earlier glimpses of the stone basin are partial and do not clearly establish a fountain.

instruction: When you see an apple and an orange together on the table, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that an apple and an orange are together on the table.
notes: A reddish apple and a yellow-orange citrus fruit are visible together on the round table from 6.0s. At 5.5s the view is blurred, and after 7.0s the fruits become partially cropped as the camera moves closer.

instruction: When the cup becomes empty, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that the cup is empty.
notes: The glass initially contains pale liquid. After it is lifted, it first appears empty when clearly visible again at 14.5s and remains visible through 17.5s. Small residual liquid cannot be ruled out visually.

instruction: When you see a blue bicycle and a yellow bicycle at the same time, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that a blue bicycle and a yellow bicycle are visible together.
notes: A blue bicycle and a yellow bicycle become clearly visible at the same time around 4.0s and remain together in view through 8.5s.

instruction: When I take a water bottle out of my bag, remind me.
notes: Negative example. A phone is taken out of the bag around 8.5s, not a water bottle; the requested action never occurs.

instruction: When I take a box out of my backpack, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that they have taken a box out of their backpack.
notes: A hand reaches into an open black backpack and lifts a black rectangular box fully out around 5.0s. The box remains briefly visible in hand through 5.5s.

instruction: When you see a yellow cat, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that a yellow cat is visible.
notes: A yellow-orange cat is curled up in a raised cat bed near the window. The cat becomes recognizable around 6.5s and remains visible through 12.0s, when the camera begins turning away.

instruction: When you see a basketball court, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that a basketball court is visible.
notes: A fenced sports area is visible earlier, but its type is initially unclear. A basketball backboard/hoop and the blue court become distinguishable around 11.5s, and part of the court remains in view through 13.0s.

instruction: When you see a FamilyMart convenience store, remind me.
notes: Negative example. A 7-Eleven convenience store is visible, but no FamilyMart store appears. The similar store category is a semantic distractor.

instruction: When you see an exit sign with black text on a white background, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that an exit sign with black text on a white background is visible.
notes: A white overhead exit sign with black lettering and a left-turn arrow first becomes recognizable at 8.0s. The sign reads 往出口 / SAÍDA and is clearly visible at 8.5s.

instruction: When I take a bottled drink out of my backpack, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that they have taken a bottled drink out of their backpack.
notes: The wearer reaches into the bag and pulls out a green bottled drink. The bottle is fully out and clearly held in hand at 5.5s, remaining clearly visible through 6.0s.

instruction: When the traffic light ahead turns green, remind me that it is time to start driving.
expected_action: Remind the user that the traffic light ahead has turned green and it is time to start driving.
notes: The traffic lights ahead are red at 5.0s and turn green at 5.5s. The green signal remains visible as the vehicles begin moving.

instruction: When you see an N22 building sign, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that the N22 sign is visible.
notes: The black N22 building marker enters view on the right side of the walkway and becomes readable at 5.5s. It remains visible as the camera moves closer.

instruction: When I open the refrigerator door, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that they have opened the refrigerator door.
notes: The refrigerator door is closed earlier. An opening gap and the illuminated refrigerator interior are visible at 7.0s, and the door stays open until about 10.0s.

instruction: When you see an apple on the table, remind me.
notes: Negative example. Oranges and other objects are visible, but no apple is clearly present on the table.

instruction: When you see a drink and an apple on the table at the same time, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that a drink and an apple are together on the table.
notes: A bottled drink and a red apple on the round table become clearly visible together around 5.0s and remain in view through 6.0s before the camera moves away.

instruction: When you see a yellow bicycle, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that a yellow bicycle is visible.
notes: Yellow shared bicycles appear beside the recycling information board. A yellow bicycle is identifiable from 5.5s, with a clearer unobstructed view in following frames.

instruction: When you see a drink and an orange on the table at the same time, remind me.
notes: Negative example. A drink and an apple are visible on the table, but the required orange is not present together with the drink.

instruction: When the parking barrier arm is fully raised, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that the parking barrier arm is fully raised.
notes: The parking barrier arm rises from horizontal to a steep angle. It is still moving upward at 8.5s and appears fully raised around 9.0s as the car proceeds through the gate. The exact completion frame is slightly uncertain because the raised arm moves out of view.

instruction: When you see a 7-Eleven convenience store, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that a 7-Eleven convenience store is visible.
notes: A 7-Eleven storefront with its recognizable illuminated logo and green-orange-red branding becomes clearly visible around 4.0s. The storefront remains visible until the camera turns away.

instruction: When I take a bottled water out of my backpack, remind me.
expected_action: Remind the user that they have taken a bottled water out of their backpack.
notes: The wearer reaches into the bag and pulls out a green bottled water. The bottle is fully out and clearly held in hand at 5.5s, remaining clearly visible through 6.0s.

instruction: When I fully open the door, remind me.
notes: Negative example. The door opens only a narrow gap around 8.5s and remains partially open; it is never fully opened.

instruction: When I pet a dog, remind me.
notes: Negative example. The wearer pets an orange cat on a sofa around 7.5–11.5s, not a dog; the requested action never occurs.
